messages:
lena_pm: Quick sync on Q2 Console observability sprint. TL;DR: per-route cost dashboards, lightweight tracing hooks (span-level model + KV timing), error analytics by route/customer, and regression alerts for prompt sets. Need scope + launch criteria for EA.

omar_platform: +1. Can we rank customer asks vs platform risk? My guess: per-route cost + basic traces = highest ROI.

ben_sre: Heads up — full traces at our QPS will explode ingest cost. We should do adaptive sampling + a heatmap view first.

maya_analytics: Agreed with Ben. Also recommend materializing daily aggregates for cost, not raw tokens. That gives near-real-time dashboards without storing per-token logs.

lena_pm: Proposed MVP scope (must-have for EA):
- per-route token & $/route dashboard (daily + last 24h)
- trace hooks that emit span events for model exec and kv cache (sampled 1%)
- error analytics: top 10 routes by error-rate, with first-error example
- regression alerting: delta on prompt-set pass rate > 5%

chloe_design: UX constraint: dashboards must let users filter by model, deployment (hosted/dedicated/private), and customer-id. Mocking a compact header with quick-filters.

raj_runtime: Implementation notes: we can add a lightweight hook API like `emit_span(name, latency_ms, tags)` that runtime calls for key hot-paths. Example: `emit_span("model.forward", 42, {model: "redwood-7b", seq: 128})`. Hook will respect sampling config.

ben_sre: For sampling, suggest hybrid: 0.5% continuous + 100% for errors and 100% for requests that hit customizable heatlist routes. That keeps cost bounded.

bigbank_cust: BigBank here — per-customer cost rollup and alerting is a must for our procurement. If you can show daily spend per API-key with export, we can move to EA. Also want trace correlation id to link request -> billing.

lena_pm: Noted. Add export CSV for per-customer daily spend to MVP if feasible. For correlation id: we can add `x-rd-request-id` propagation and include in span.

maya_analytics: Alerting wire: small config UI to attach prompt-sets (list of inputs) and track pass/fail delta. Backend job runs nightly evals. If pass rate drops > threshold, create an incident with top failing examples.

omar_platform: Dependency callout: we need schema additions in telemetry pipeline and schema migration window. SRE: will this require retention or compaction changes?

ben_sre: Yes. We'll add a compacted timeseries for cost and a sampled span store for traces. Retention: raw sampled spans 7d, aggregates 90d. That should be acceptable for most customers.

chloe_design: For error analytics UX: show first-error example + 3 anonymized customer payloads. Privacy note: need PM signoff for examples from Private deployments.

lena_pm: Launch criteria proposal for EA:
- Per-route daily cost dashboard visible in Console and exportable (smoke test: sample customer shows correct totals)
- Tracing hooks instrumented in runtime with sampling enabled and span-level model timing (smoke test: span present for model.forward)
- Error analytics page with top 10 routes and first-error examples (smoke test: seeded error appears)
- Regression alert pipeline running nightly on prompt-sets (smoke test: injected failure triggers alert)
- Security signoff for customer export and Private deployments

raj_runtime: Timeline: we can wire the hook in runtime in 2 sprints, backend pipeline + aggregates 3 sprints, dashboard + UX 2 sprints. Totals ~7 sprints if parallel work limited.

maya_analytics: Metrics to measure success: time-to-answer (avg model latency), cost-per-1000-tokens per-route, #of regression alerts, number of customers using per-customer export.

lena_pm: Tradeoffs to call out during prioritization meeting:
- sampling vs fidelity (affects debugging quality)
- real-time vs nightly aggregates (affects freshness)
- exportability vs PII risk (affects Private customers)
Pick which to relax if timeline slips.

omar_platform: My vote: keep per-route cost real-time-ish (1-5m aggregates) and make traces sampled. We can add an on-demand full-trace capture for canary sessions.

ben_sre: On-demand capture is good. Add retention + purge tool for compliance.

chloe_design: Will draft quick mockups for dashboard filters + error drilldown by tomorrow.

lena_pm: Next steps:
1) Owners: Omar (platform infra) for pipeline changes, Raj (runtime) for hooks, Maya (analytics) for alerts/backfill, Chloe for UI.
2) Triage customer asks: BigBank export prioritized for EA if Omar + Ben confirm retention controls.
3) Add canary plan + acceptance tests to sprint.

deploy-bot: staging deploy queued: observability-pipeline-v2 -> staging at 1716008500 by CI.

raj_runtime: quick note — I'll open the runtime PR with `emit_span` API today.

ben_sre: 👍

lena_pm: Thanks everyone. We'll take this into prioritization meeting and come back with final scope cuts by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
